unit.title: Add me on WeChat
canDo: Read phone numbers the Chinese way
Answer the phone and arrange a call

example.en: Let's add each other on WeChat!

example.py: Nǐ de shǒujī hào shì duōshao?
Nǐ gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà ba.
Wǒ yíhuìr gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.
example.en: I'll call you in a bit.

vocabulary.usageNote: On the phone it's said wéi (rising). Only for phone calls.

example.zh: 你告诉我你的手机号吧。
example.py: Nǐ gàosu wǒ nǐ de shǒujī hào ba.

example.en: OK, see you in a bit!

grammar.purpose: Say who you do something for or to
grammar.explanation: 给 introduces the person, before the verb: 我给你打电话 (I to you make a call = I'll call you). Same order as 在 + place: the extra detail comes before the action.

examples.py: Nǐ gěi wǒ dǎ diànhuà ba.
Wǒ yíhuìr gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.
examples.en: I'll call you in a bit.

commonMistakes.why: Time and 给 + person both come before the verb.

grammar.pattern: Phone numbers: digit by digit, 一 = yāo
grammar.explanation: Read numbers one digit at a time, often in groups: 138 0627 5914. In phone, room and bus numbers 一 is read yāo so it can't be confused with 七 qī. Ask: 你的手机号是多少？

examples.zh: 一三八，零六二七，五九一四。
examples.py: Yāo sān bā, líng liù èr qī, wǔ jiǔ yāo sì.
Nǐ de shǒujī hào shì duōshao?

dialogue.title: Swapping numbers
dialogue.setting: After the language exchange, Chen Yu wants to stay in touch with Anna.

lines.speaker: chenyu
lines.en: Shall we add each other on WeChat?

lines.speaker: anna
lines.zh: 我没有微信。你的手机号是多少？
lines.py: Wǒ méiyǒu Wēixìn. Nǐ de shǒujī hào shì duōshao?
lines.en: I don't have WeChat. What's your number?

lines.speaker: chenyu
lines.zh: 一三八，零六二七，五九一四。
lines.py: Yāo sān bā, líng liù èr qī, wǔ jiǔ yāo sì.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.zh: 慢一点儿！一三八，然后呢？
lines.py: Màn yìdiǎnr! Yāo sān bā, ránhòu ne?

lines.speaker: chenyu
lines.py: Líng liù èr qī, wǔ jiǔ yāo sì.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.zh: 好，我一会儿给你打电话。
lines.py: Hǎo, wǒ yíhuìr gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.
lines.en: OK, I'll call you in a bit.

reading.title: First messages
reading.blurb: Chen Yu and Anna's first chat.
reading.purpose: Read their first messages. When will they meet, and how will they find each other?

lines.speaker: chenyu
lines.py: Nǐ hǎo! Wǒ shì Chén Yǔ.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.py: Nǐ hǎo! Hěn gāoxìng rènshi nǐ.

lines.speaker: chenyu
lines.zh: 你明天有空吗？我们一起喝咖啡吧。
lines.py: Nǐ míngtiān yǒu kòng ma? Wǒmen yìqǐ hē kāfēi ba.
lines.en: Are you free tomorrow? Let's get a coffee.

lines.speaker: anna
lines.zh: 明天我不能去，那星期六怎么样？
lines.py: Míngtiān wǒ bù néng qù, nà xīngqīliù zěnmeyàng?

lines.speaker: chenyu
lines.zh: 好！星期六下午三点，我给你打电话。
lines.py: Hǎo! Xīngqīliù xiàwǔ sān diǎn, wǒ gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.
lines.en: Great! Saturday at 3, I'll call you.

conversation.aiPartnerBrief: You are 陈宇. Ask for the learner's number and read yours digit by digit with 一 as yāo.

pragmatics.situation: Asking a new friend to stay in touch

natural.en: Let's add each other on WeChat!

tooFormal.zh: 请问，可以告诉我您的联系方式吗？
tooFormal.py: Qǐngwèn, kěyǐ gàosu wǒ nín de liánxì fāngshì ma?

pragmatics.note: In China, WeChat is the normal way to keep in touch, even with new acquaintances.
Every call starts with 喂. Add 你好 for someone you don't know.

audio.py: Wǒ yíhuìr gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà.
audio.en: I'll call you in a bit.

tasks.why: 一会儿 means in a moment.

audio.zh: 我的手机号是一三九，零零一七。
audio.py: Wǒ de shǒujī hào shì yāo sān jiǔ, líng líng yāo qī.

tasks.why: 一三九 is 1-3-9; yāo is how 一 sounds in numbers.
